hook: Pip the hero fox has a whole day ahead. The class votes at each moment, brush or skip, water or soda, sleep or screens, and Pip's energy, clean and smile meters show what each habit does.
outcome: Choose daily healthy habits (brushing, handwashing, water, moving, sleep) and explain how they help the body
sources: Illustrations drawn with FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (Apache 2.0) on Cloudflare Workers AI, edited for Curio Class
Illustrations drawn with FLUX.1-schnell (Apache 2.0) on a local computer, edited for Curio Class
Facts from CDC handwashing guidance, the American Dental Association and AASM/AAP sleep guidance
Music and sounds generated in the browser
